function trySpawnDocileAnimal(ground:Part)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] == false then return end
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    -- 获得敌人随机组id
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local animalIds = _docileAnimalIdsMap[zoneLevel]
    if not animalIds then
        _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] = false
        return
    end

    local animalId = animalIds[math.random(1,#animalIds)]
    if _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] == nil then
        local amimalLo:DocileAnimalSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(DocileAnimalSetting,animalId)
        _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= amimalLo.spawnPercent
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local amimalLo:DocileAnimalSetting.Type = EnemyHelper:GetDocileAnimalLo(animalId)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(amimalLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateDocileAnimal(amimalLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal

    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
end

function trySpawnAnimals(ground:Part)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    -- 获得敌人随机组id
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local enemyIds = _enemyIdsMap[zoneLevel]
    if not enemyIds then
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
        return
    end

    local enemyId = enemyIds[math.random(1,#enemyIds)]
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == nil then
        local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(EnemySetting,enemyId)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= enemyLo.spawnPercent
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(EnemySetting,enemyId)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(enemyLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal

    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
end


-- 宝箱点
function initTreasurePoint()
    local parent = Instance.new("Folder")
    parent.Name = "雪原区域宝箱点"
    parent.Parent = _parent

    local prefabs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("雪原Map"):FindFirstChild("宝箱资源点"):GetChildren()
    local gridType = MapHelper.GridType.building
    -- local num = math.random(15,20)
    local density = GameHelper.SnowfieldSize / 40 -- 计算密度  676
    local num = math.random(math.ceil(density * 0.9),math.ceil(density * 1.1))
    local grounds = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldGround)
    for i=1,num do
        if #grounds <= 0 then break end
        local prefab = prefabs[math.random(1,#prefabs)]
        local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
        local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
        local width = math.max(sizeX,sizeZ)
        for j=1,10 do
            local ground = grounds[math.random(1,#grounds)]
            local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
            if not grid1Vo then
                warn("找不到地块坐标值",ground.Name)
            end
            local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
            local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
            -- 避免在边缘生成
            if grid1X <= width or grid1X >= MapHelper.mapSize_1 - width or grid1Z <= width or grid1Z >= MapHelper.mapSize_1 - width then continue end
            -- 非雪地地块
            if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield) then continue end

            local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,gridType,prefab)
            MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
            building.Parent = parent
            break
        end
    end
end

function spawnBuilding(prefab:Model,levels:{number})
    local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
    local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
    local grounds:{Part} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldGround)
    for i=1,#grounds do
        local ground = table.remove(grounds,math.random(1,#grounds))
        local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
        local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
        local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if table.find(levels,zoneLevel) == nil then
            continue
        end
        if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield) then continue end
        local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.building,prefab)
        MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
        building.Parent = _parent
        print("生成",prefab.Name,grid1X,grid1Z)
        return building
    end
end

-- 生成驯鹿
function trySpawnReindeer(ground:Part)
    if _reindeerSpawnGrounds then
        if #_reindeerSpawnGrounds == 0 then return end
    else
        _reindeerSpawnGrounds = {}
        local gridPoints = MapHelper.ZoneMap1[2]
        for i=1,100 do
            local gridPoint = gridPoints[math.random(1,#gridPoints)]
            local grid1X = gridPoint.x
            local grid1Z = gridPoint.z

            local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.land then continue end

            local g = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if not g then continue end

            table.insert(_reindeerSpawnGrounds,g)
            if #_reindeerSpawnGrounds >= 6 then break end
        end
    end

    local index = table.find(_reindeerSpawnGrounds,ground)
    if not index then return end
    table.remove(_reindeerSpawnGrounds,index)
    
    print("生成驯鹿",ground.Name)
    local rotationY = math.random(1,359)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local position = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(Vector3.new(        
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)))
    local horse = GameHelper:CreateReindeer(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0) + position + Vector3.yAxis * 3)
    horse:AddTag("Reindeer")
end

function initSantaClausEvent()

function spawnEnemy()
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local ranged = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange() + 20
    local campfireCFrame = campfire:GetPivot()
    local campfirePos = campfireCFrame.Position

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(MapHelper:GetWantedBoard())
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(MapHelper:GetCraftingBenchModels())
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    _enemyParent:ClearAllChildren()
    local lo:CampRaidSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CampRaidSetting,_waveId)
    local enemyIds = string.split(lo.enemyIds,",")

        local enemyId = tonumber(emenyIdStr)
        local enemy:Model = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,_enemyParent)
        local spawnPos:Vector3
        for i=1,20 do
            local x,z = CommonFunc:GetDir2D(math.random() * 2 * math.pi)
            spawnPos = MapHelper:GetLandingPoint(Vector3.new(x * ranged,campfirePos.Y,z * ranged))
            local point = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(spawnPos)
            if point then
                -- 检测是否被悬赏牌和马车阻挡
                local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(point,(campfirePos - point).Unit * 100,raycastParams)

                    spawnPos = point
                    break

                    -- print(hitResult.Instance.Name)
                end
            end
        end
        enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spawnPos))

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.GhostBuilding,function(building:Model, connections)
    local canSpawnAttMarks:{Attachment} = {}
    local atts:{Attachment} = building:FindFirstChild("幽灵生成点"):GetChildren()

    -- 幽灵父对象
    local ghostParent:Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    ghostParent.Name = "幽灵"
    ghostParent.Parent = building

    local clearGhost = function()
        for _,ghost:Model in ipairs(ghostParent:GetChildren()) do
            ghost.Parent = nil
            Debris:AddItem(ghost,1)
        end
    end

    local checkSpawn = function()
        if not MapHelper:GetBuildingActivity(building) then return end
        if v_isDaytime.Value then return end
        if #ghostParent:GetChildren() > 0 then return end

        for att:Attachment,canSpawn in pairs(canSpawnAttMarks) do
            if not canSpawn then continue end
            local ghostId = tonumber(att.Name)
            if not ghostId then continue end

            local ghost = EnemyHelper:Create(ghostId,ghostParent)
            ghost:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame)

            local humanoid:Humanoid = ghost:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            humanoid.Died:Once(function()
                canSpawnAttMarks[att] = false
            end)

            GameHelper.onBuildingSpawnEnemy:Fire(building,ghost)
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections,v_isDaytime.Changed:Connect(function()
        if v_isDaytime.Value then
            -- 白天清理所有幽灵
            -- ghostParent:ClearAllChildren()
            clearGhost()
        else
            if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                for _,att in ipairs(atts) do
                    if not att:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
                    canSpawnAttMarks[att] = true
                end
            end
            checkSpawn()
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onBuildingEnter.Event:Connect(function(player:Player,b:Model)
        if b ~= building then return end

        checkSpawn()
    end))

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onBuildingExit.Event:Connect(function(player:Player,b:Model)
        if b ~= building then return end

        if not MapHelper:GetBuildingActivity(building) then
            -- 清理所有幽灵
            -- ghostParent:ClearAllChildren()
            clearGhost()
        end
    end))
end)

        print(string.format("套用模式 %d 数值 Start ---------------------",modeId))
        for _,v_congfig:NumberValue in ipairs(values) do
            local targetValue:NumberValue = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild(v_congfig.Name)
            if targetValue then
                print(string.format("%s %s->%s",targetValue.Name,tostring(targetValue.Value),tostring(v_congfig.Value)))
                targetValue.Value = v_congfig.Value
            else
                warn("未定义的数值:",v_congfig.Name)
            end
        end
        print(string.format("套用模式 %d 数值 End ---------------------",modeId))
    else
        -- warn("未找到模式数值配置:",modeId)
    end
    v_gameMode.Value = modeId
    GameHelper.gameModeInit = true
    GameHelper.onGameModeInitComplete:Fire(modeId)
end

function onCharacterAdded(player:Player,character:Model)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(character,CharacterValue)
    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

    local characterId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.characterId)
    local characterLo = CharacterHelper:GetLo(characterId)
    local chestplateId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId)
    local faceMaskId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId)
    local shoeId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId)
    local scarfId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId)

    -- 设置串流模式
    character.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
    -- 带上帽子；挑战角色可配置为强制无帽
    if characterLo and characterLo.forceNoHat then
        CharacterHelper:ClearHat(character,true)
    else
        CharacterHelper:ChangedHat(character,characterId)
    end
    -- 重新穿上盔甲
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,chestplateId)
    -- 重新穿上面罩
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,faceMaskId)
    -- 重新穿上围巾
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,scarfId)
    -- 重新穿上鞋子
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,shoeId)

    character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        CharacterHelper:ClearHat(character)
    end)

    humanoid.Died:Once(function()
        -- 看看是不是有复活棺材
        local RespawnCoffins:{Model} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.RespawnCoffin)
        for _,coffin in ipairs(RespawnCoffins) do
            local v_activate:BoolValue = coffin:FindFirstChild("activate")
            local v_triggerTimes:IntValue = coffin:FindFirstChild("triggerTimes")
            if v_activate and v_activate.Value then
                -- 有激活的复活棺材，复活玩家
                GameHelper:PlayerDiedButRespawnCoffin(player)
                v_activate.Value = false
                v_triggerTimes.Value += 1

                -- 播放复活特效
                EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("Respawn",nil,character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),5)

                local RebirthPoint:Attachment = coffin:FindFirstChild("RebirthPoint")
                local Fire:Fire = RebirthPoint:FindFirstChild("Fire")
                local RespawnSound:Sound = coffin:FindFirstChild("Main"):FindFirstChild("RespawnSound")
                Fire.Enabled = true
                task.wait(3)

                GameHelper:PlayerRevive(player)
                local newCharacter = player.Character
                newCharacter:PivotTo(RebirthPoint.WorldCFrame)
                
                -- 播放复活特效
                EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("Respawn",nil,newCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),1)

                RespawnSound:Play()
                task.wait(1)
                Fire.Enabled = false
                return
            end
        end

        -- 有额外的复活次数，消耗并复活
        local v_ReviveTimes:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.ReviveTimes)
        if v_ReviveTimes.Value > 0 then
            v_ReviveTimes.Value -= 1
            GameHelper:PlayerDiedButRevive(player)

            EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("Respawn",nil,character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),5)
            EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("复活光柱",character)
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("复活光柱",character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            task.wait(3)

            local revivePos = character:GetPivot().Position
            GameHelper:PlayerRevive(player)
            local newCharacter = player.Character
            newCharacter:PivotTo(CFrame.new(revivePos))

            -- 播放复活特效
            EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("Respawn",nil,newCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),3)
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("RespawnSound",newCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            return
        end

        GameHelper:PlayerDied(player)
    end)

    character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
        if parent == nil then
            -- print("移除了")
            local handTool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if handTool and ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(handTool) then
                ToolHelper:Store(player,handTool)
            end
        end
    end)
    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(character,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Player)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player)
end

function onInitPlayerVo(player:Player)
    local userId = player.UserId
    GameHelper:CancelPlayerSessionCleanup(userId)
    cancelTreasureCleanup(userId)

    if not DataHelper:IsInit(player) then return end

    ToolHelper:InitBackpack(player)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(player,PlayerAttributeValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(player,PlayerValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(player,PlayerStatsValue)

    local playerGameData = GameHelper:GetPlayerGameData(player)
    if playerGameData then
        player:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId,playerGameData.chestplateId)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId,playerGameData.faceMaskId)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId,playerGameData.scarfId)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId,playerGameData.shoeId)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.ReviveTimes,playerGameData.reviveTimes)
        GameHelper:SetRideLv(player,playerGameData.rideLv)

        for _,bulletTag in ipairs(GameEnum.BulletTags) do
            local num = playerGameData.bullets[bulletTag] or 0
            ValueHelper:SetValue(player,bulletTag,num)
        end
    else
        local joinData = player:GetJoinData() or {}
        local teleportVo:CommonType.TeleportLobbyToWild = joinData["TeleportData"]
        if not teleportVo then
            teleportVo = {}
            if RunService:IsStudio() and GameEnum.TestCharacterEnable then
                teleportVo.characterId = GameEnum.TestCharacterId
                teleportVo.level = GameEnum.TestCharacterLv
            else
                local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
                if playerVo then
                    local characterVo = DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(player,playerVo.characterId)
                    teleportVo.characterId = characterVo and characterVo.id or 0
                    teleportVo.level = characterVo and characterVo.lv or 1
                else
                    teleportVo.characterId = 0
                    teleportVo.level = 1
                end
            end
        end
        playerGameData = GameHelper:CreatePlayerGameData(player,teleportVo)
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
        initMode(teleportVo)
    end

    local characterId = playerGameData.teleportVo.characterId
    local characterLv = playerGameData.teleportVo.level

    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.ReviveTimes).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    for _,bulletTag in ipairs(GameEnum.BulletTags) do
        ValueHelper:FindValue(player,bulletTag).Changed:Connect(function()
            GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
        end)
    end
